title: Tech View cells show a blue number, a thin progress bar and the advisor's avatar
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in with the "Admin" role at location "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919" (on another site: the location named in the test run).
  • The browser window is 1440 px wide with the zoom at 100%, and the design picture "DC-05-tech-view-rows-regular-light-1440.png" attached to this case is open beside it at 100% (actual size). Names, numbers and the rank numbers in the pictures are sample data.
  • Technicians "ZZAUTOTEST C590114 Eva" (with a profile photo) and "ZZAUTOTEST C590114 Finn" (no photo) are active at this location.
  • Customer "ZZAUTOTEST C590114 Cell Styles" has an Approved work order, unit "C590114-U1", led by "ZZAUTOTEST C590114 Eva", with a service advisor and one approved line whose technician is "ZZAUTOTEST C590114 Finn", who is clocked in to it; and an Invoiced work order, unit "C590114-U2", led by "ZZAUTOTEST C590114 Eva".
  • Starting screen: "Work Orders" > "All" tab, "Tech View" shown, "Search" holding "ZZAUTOTEST C590114 Cell Styles", no filter chosen, "Assigned to me" off, density "Regular".
  • If any record named above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Look at the "Number" cell of the row for unit "C590114-U1".
  2. Look at the "Progress" cell of the same row.
  3. Look at where the "Status", "Waiting On Parts" and "Progress" cells sit in their columns.
  4. Look at the "Service Advisor" cell.
  5. Look at the "Assigned Techs" cell.
  6. Hover the first avatar in the "Assigned Techs" cell.
  7. Look at the "Waiting On Parts", "Clocked In" and "Total price" cells.
  8. Look at the "Number" cell of the row for unit "C590114-U2".
  9. Hover the small padlock next to that number.
  10. Click "List" in the display switcher.
custom_expected:
Step 1: the number is blue like a link, a little darker than the blue numbers in the design picture, not black.

Step 2: a thin rounded bar with the percentage beside it in small grey text (such as 0%), about as long as the word "Progress" in the header, as in the picture.

Step 3: all three sit at the left of their columns.

Step 4: a small round avatar sits before the advisor's name.

Step 5: overlapping round avatars, "ZZAUTOTEST C590114 Eva" (the lead) first, then "ZZAUTOTEST C590114 Finn".

Step 6: a name bubble reading "ZZAUTOTEST C590114 Eva" opens above the avatar.

Step 7: "Waiting On Parts" shows a grey dash (-), not a blank, and "Total price" sits at the right of its column.

Step 8: a small padlock outline icon sits right after the number.

Step 9: a dark tooltip with light text opens above the padlock.

Step 10: List's "Clocked In" cell shows the same thing in the same style as Tech View's at step 7.

AUTOMATION: READY
